messages:
sarah: Quick question — SOC asked for an evidence retention SLO for SIEM exports. Do we have a single canonical SLA or is it per-customer/feature?
omar: Short answer: we don't have one single SLA. By default export artifacts are retained 30d, but we have per-customer exceptions and archival paths.
devon: Also important: KMS unwrap tokens are ephemeral. We don't keep plaintext long-term.
leah: SOC wants a documented path for legal evidence (they're asking for 90d as a minimum). Can we support per-tenant extended retention on exports?
sarah: @omar can we add a per-tenant override to the export service config? That needs RBAC checks and an auditable justification flow.
omar: Technically yes. We'll need: (a) tenant flag + contract guard, (b) RBAC gating for who can request/approve, (c) JIT KMS unwrap tokens, (d) chain-of-custody metadata. Also billing needs to be aware if retention > default.
maria: From compliance: reviewer role should be strictly "forensics-analyst" or legal. No dev access to unwrapped artifacts.
devon: Proposed minimal config snippet to make this concrete:
```
export_policy:
  ttl_days: 30
  max_override_days: 180
  required_role: "forensics-analyst"
  kms_unwrap_token_ttl_hours: 12
```
leah: That looks sensible. How do we ensure the audit log captures proof of access and decisioning?
security-bot: Deploy note: export-service v2.3 rolled at 2026-03-15 09:12 UTC (includes basic ttl override flags behind FF)
omar: Audit should capture: requestor identity, role, justification text, approval ticket id, CMK id used for unwrap, unwrap request id, and artifact hash. Those entries should be immutable for the configured retention window.
sarah: We need to reconcile default 30d vs SOC 90d vs regulated customers asking for 365d archive. Recommend tiers: default 30d, legal-evidence 90d, regulated-archival 365d (cold tier). Document SLA matrix.
devon: RBAC changes: add permission `siem:export:unwrap`. Add a managed group `analyst:siem_unwrap` mapped to forensics and legal. Tests needed to ensure least privilege.
leah: For emergency debugging, product wants dev access, but we should require breakglass with 2 approvers and automatic revoke.
omar: Breakglass flow prototype: ephemeral admin token creation requires 2 approvers from list [sec-lead, oncall]; token TTL = 1h; token issuance and approval steps logged with cryptographic signature.
maria: Legal also asked for chain-of-custody: include signed metadata alongside each export: {artifact_hash, exported_by, exported_at, cmk_signed_blob}. We should sign with CMK signing key so customers/legal can verify integrity.
sarah: Action items: 1) update export config schema to include ttl tiers and override meta (owner: @omar) 2) add RBAC permission + reviewer group + policy tests (owner: @devon) 3) implement JIT KMS unwrap flow + signed chain-of-custody (owner: @omar) 4) draft SLA/retention matrix and SOC runbook updates (owner: @leah) 5) prototype signed evidence package (owner: @maria)
omar: I'll take 1 & 3. Tentative ETA: 2 weeks (depends on KMS signing API coordination).
devon: I'll add the RBAC permission and policy tests in infra-auth. ETA: 1 week.
leah: I'll draft the SLA matrix and update the runbook with breakglass steps and approval checklist.
maria: I'll prototype a small PoC that produces signed metadata and a verifiable manifest (hash chain).
sarah: I'll file the umbrella ticket and link the SOC request. Please post snippets/log examples to the ticket.
devon: Quick Q — where should we keep the long-retention audit logs to be tamper-evident? We discussed options before.
omar: Use GCS with object versioning + CMEK + signed manifests pushed daily to archive bucket. Keep manifests signed and store copies in two regions.
leah: Noted. Also alert product about potential billing adjustments for extended retention (inform customer ops).
sarah: Small UX ask: add retention flag to tenant profile in Console (hidden behind FF until rollout). Only admins should toggle. :thumbsup:
omar: Will include flag in export-service API and Console feature flag gating.
maria: One more: for evidence requests, include a required ticket id and justification length > 20 chars in the request schema to avoid empty notes.
sarah: Good. I'll add that to the ticket. Thanks everyone. Closing notes: let's sync next week for progress and demo PoC for signing.
